Corporate Event Transportation Checklist for Planners

The complete guide for event planners coordinating corporate transportation. Ensure flawless logistics for your next conference, retreat, or meeting.

Pre-Planning Phase (6+ Weeks Out)

Assess Transportation Needs

  • [ ] Total attendee count
  • [ ] VIP/executive count requiring separate service
  • [ ] Airport arrival/departure windows
  • [ ] Event venue locations
  • [ ] Hotel locations
  • [ ] Off-site dinner/activity venues

Budget Planning

  • [ ] Establish transportation budget
  • [ ] Prioritize VIP vs. general attendee service
  • [ ] Include gratuity and incidentals
  • [ ] Build in 10% contingency

Vendor Selection (4-6 Weeks Out)

Request Proposals

  • [ ] Fleet range (SUVs, Sprinters, mini coaches, a motorcoach)
  • [ ] Availability for all required dates/times
  • [ ] Insurance and licensing verification
  • [ ] References from similar events
  • [ ] Backup vehicle policies

Contract Essentials

  • [ ] Detailed pricing breakdown
  • [ ] Overtime policies
  • [ ] Cancellation terms
  • [ ] Contact escalation procedures
  • [ ] Payment terms

Logistics Planning (2-4 Weeks Out)

Create Transportation Matrix

  • [ ] Flight arrival tracker (all attendees)
  • [ ] Vehicle assignments
  • [ ] Driver schedules
  • [ ] Pickup/drop-off locations
  • [ ] Timeline for each movement

Coordinate with Venues

  • [ ] Confirm loading zones
  • [ ] Identify staging areas
  • [ ] Verify parking for buses
  • [ ] Establish signage needs

Week-Of Execution

Final Confirmations

  • [ ] Reconfirm all reservations
  • [ ] Update flight tracking
  • [ ] Distribute contact sheets
  • [ ] Brief drivers on VIP protocols

Day-Of Management

  • [ ] Real-time tracking of all vehicles
  • [ ] Communication with drivers
  • [ ] Attendee notifications
  • [ ] Contingency activation if needed
